info.title: Agent Embassy — Tier 0 / Tier 1
info.description: Public catalog (Tier 0) and domain-verification (Tier 1) endpoints, wrapped as MCP tools by LiteLLM. Tier 2/3 are deliberately not included here -- they require mTLS with the caller's own client certificate, which an MCP gateway cannot forward on a caller's behalf without impersonating every caller as itself.

get.summary: Fetch the Agent Embassy manifest: entity info, links to the public catalog files, and the access tiers this company supports. Start here.
Fetch the public product catalog (schema.org ItemList of Products). No authentication required.
Fetch the public services catalog (schema.org ItemList). No authentication required.
Fetch the public open-positions catalog (schema.org ItemList). No authentication required.
Fetch the public supplier-needs catalog (schema.org ItemList). No authentication required.

post.summary: Step 1 of Tier 1 domain verification. Claim a domain you control; get back a one-time token to publish at https://<your-domain>/.well-known/agent-embassy-challenge.txt. Call with arguments: {"body": {"domain": "your-domain.example"}} -- the domain goes inside a nested 'body' object, not as a top-level argument.

domain.description: The domain you control, e.g. example.com

200.description: Challenge token and where to publish it.

post.summary: Step 2 of Tier 1 domain verification. Call after publishing the challenge token from tier1_challenge. On success, returns a session_token -- pass it as 'Authorization: Bearer <session_token>' (a header on the MCP call itself, not a tool argument) to call get_contact. Call with arguments: {"body": {"domain": "your-domain.example"}}.

get.summary: Fetch contact-routing details. Requires a valid Tier 1 session token from tier1_verify, sent as the 'Authorization: Bearer <session_token>' header on the MCP call itself. Without it, or with an expired/invalid token, this returns an authorization-error page as its content -- check the actual text for 'contact' fields, a successful-looking tool result is not proof of success.

200.description: Contact details, or an authorization error page as plain content.
